description: How a link went: waiting, connected, reconnected, disconnected, done (a key or webhook was made), failed or expired, with the account_id once known and a reason when it failed. A brand link stays waiting for its hour; the brand itself is the result. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /linkedin/connect/link/{handle}, group connect.

handle.description: Value for the {handle} segment of /linkedin/connect/link/{handle}. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
